provenance.method: Gaussian-smoothed DEM; zero derivative along most concave Hessian eigenvector; negative curvature, two-sided drop and length filters. No flight coordinates used.
provenance.limitations: Approximate, scale-dependent crests; not an official or exhaustive ridge network. Gaps remain at weak ridges, orientation transitions and junctions; no invented links.
